qa_triage.pins_are_snapshot_of: Snapshot C of the independent triage: an exact-SHA LOCAL probe at #252 fdc223f on the real daemon boundary. QA_PARTIAL with no signature and no PASS. Its new open P0s supersede the 'pending recheck' state recorded in manifest -d.

findings.summary: intent_digest omitted session_ref and agent_runtime, so the same key sent to another session or runtime was answered as a REPLAY. Snapshot C closes this at LOCAL: target, runtime and principal are in the digest, all three axes return CONFLICT, and no/expired context and self-asserted principal are refused.

The observation-to-SETTLED judgment was not wired into the production path and the write entry could self-attest. Snapshot C rates this PARTIAL: no/expired context and self-asserted principal are refused, a settle needs a result and a prior attempt, and restart retry is fenced — but D3 and D4 below remain open.
D3 cross-actor forgery: another trusted actor can settle A's attempt using A's copied digest and a fabricated result. The write is accepted and the principal becomes the settler.
D4 terminal-state regression: a terminal SETTLED can be written back to CALL_NOT_SENT, after which the kernel returns PROCEED, so a retry becomes a second effect.

test_no_node_paths_in_product_data.py failed at 494f452 on an inherited absolute home literal in fleet_mcp/deploy/release_plan.py. Snapshot B re-ran the full guard independently at 4a5d0a0: 10 tests OK, exit 0 (LOCAL). Closed at that SHA.

G1 present-but-null is read as an affirmative answer: {"health": null, "policy": null} yields READY/ALLOWED and a non-null effective, so a negative invariant is bypassed. The QA artifact rates this P1; the campaign brief called it P0 — recorded here at the rate the evidence supports.
_same_writer matches an empty or partial writer record: current_writer={} equals a reconciler with every field absent. Snapshot C keeps this OPEN and adds that reconcile has no production caller.
I1 manifest drift: earlier manifests pinned stale heads and omitted new candidates. Fixed in manifest -e, which pins fdc223f, 4a5d0a0, 619cf63, c2e2e8d and QA Snapshot C a9c3ea5.

Gate level inconsistency: FLEET_NEXT_33_6 requires REAL_DEVICE while its supporting rows are SOURCE. This is intentional — a gate may require more than it has and then reports BLOCKED — but it must not be read as a near-PASS.
